name: Scroll-Driven Image Reveal
description: Images fade in and open like a curtain as they enter the viewport, a clip-path inset interpolated along a named CSS view timeline. Pure CSS, zero JavaScript, with a fully visible fallback for unsupported browsers.
usage: Include styles.css and add class imr-reveal to any img, inline SVG, video or media block you want unveiled on scroll. Tune the starting slit per element with inline --imr-hide-y and --imr-hide-x custom properties, and adjust the timing window via the animation-range in styles.css.
